parameters.query:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND approval_stage='final_delivery' AND decision='approved' AND reviewer_type='human') AS final_human_approved,
  '{{$json.job_id}}' AS job_id,
  '{{$json.mode}}' AS mode,
  ('{{$json.mode}}'='live') AS live_mode;
